notes.title: Tutorial video
notes.content: - Added tutorial video to the TV inside of the starting house that explains how the gun mechanic works

notes.title: Gun Mechanic Adjustment
notes.content: -Adjusted gun to only charge up once and have 1 "Max" Jump per aim in. Previously the gun would charge and discharge in an infinite cycle while aiming, which was unnecessary and only caused confusion to some players on how the gun mechanic worked.
